events.title: Pisgah Rage Pre-season
events.description: Pre-season activities including social events, rider assessment, bike shop night, parent meeting, and adventure rides in Bent Creek or Dupont

events.title: Pisgah Rage Regular Season
events.description: Regular season with races and practices. January includes 2-4 indoor training opportunities. February includes 1 weekend practice per week. March-May includes 2 rides per week with races typically 5-6 times across the state.
